Built the support request form in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using Strata components (`Select`, `TextField`, `TextArea`, `FileUpload`, `RadioGroup`) and mock topic data defined in the file.

- Topic (`Select`), subject (`TextField`), description (`TextArea` with a live "N characters left" counter plus the built-in `n/500` count, capped via `maxLength`), an optional attachment (`FileUpload`), and a contact-preference `RadioGroup` (email / phone / no preference) with icons.
- Client-side validation on submit (topic, subject, description required) shows inline errors via each field's `errorMessage`.
- On successful submit, the form is replaced by a confirmation view with a success icon and a generated reference number (e.g. `SR-2026-AB12C`), plus a button to raise another request.

I couldn't run the app to visually verify it, so please check it in a browser when convenient.
